Sasha: PSA — PR #61422 changes allocation fallback. need infra + runtime + security eyes before we merge. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/61422
Tom: on it. is this changing allocator limits or just fallback logic? any perf numbers yet?
Izzy: i can run a perf sweep — what9s the repro workload? cc @Lia for kms/hsm checks.
Sasha: TL;DR: when pinned memory is exhausted we switch to a proportional-free fallback instead of full eviction. on synthetic llm_sim we saw ~2% p99 tail bump at high concurrency. artifacts: https://storage.redwood/alloc-61422
Sasha: repro command:
```
./dev/tools/run_alloc_bench --workload=llm_sim --iterations=50 --concurrency=120
```
Lia: i'll do a targeted security scan for any KMS/HSM interactions. if this touches page-level encryption configs i need the config diff; otherwise i can do expedited review later today.
Tom: :eyes: running a short smoke now. if ci is green i'll kick off the longer perf job overnight.
ci-bot: Build #2197 for PR 61422 	6 SUCCESS 	6 unit tests passed
Izzy: smoke finished 	6 attaching a tiny log snippet. p99 moved from 145ms -> 148ms under the repro, not ideal but within our canary guardrails. suggest trying `--eviction-threshold=0.7` toggle to evaluate.
Sasha: platform/ops 	6 can we lock a canary window? ideally merge to staging today and canary tomorrow morning PST.
Oliver: i can take the canary steward slot 09:00-11:00 PST tomorrow. add me as merge steward and i'll watch telemetry. we also need a rollback owner/plan.
Sasha: assigning owners: Oliver = canary steward, Izzy = runtime rollback owner, Tom = infra rollback owner. plan is in the PR description.
Lia: security looks OK pending a small docs note on the KMS config change. i'll add comments in the PR and mark for expedited approve once addressed.
Tom: infra LGTM after the overnight perf run completes (so far so good). :+1:
Izzy: runtime conditional LGTM 	6 i'll monitor the canary and revert if the tail gets worse. :shipit:
Sasha: updated PR with test artifacts and the canary checklist. please drop a short "LGTM" in the PR when you have it so we can merge during the merge steward slot. thanks! :pray:
